name: Berkeley Fall 2017

venue.name: Saturday (the side events day) will be held in 155 Dwinelle. Sunday (the main day) will be held in the Pauley Ballroom.
venue.address: Pauley Ballroom, 2475 Bancroft Way, Berkeley, CA 94720

information: * Registration is capped at 220 people; there will be no walk-on competitors under any circumstances. **You must register online in order to compete.** * Saturday has the following events: FMC (1 attempt), Multi-BLD (1 attempt), Clock, 6x6 and 7x7. * Sunday has the following events: 3x3, 3x3 One-Handed, 2x2, 5x5 and Megaminx. The venue is the Pauley Ballroom, on the south side of campus. * Please read the information tabs on this website for crucial information.
